## FLAGSHIP PROJECTS (For Case Studies)

### 1. UniArchive — OCR + Semantic Search for Academic Documents
**Role:** Solo Full-Stack Engineer (Final-Year Project)  
**Stack:** FastAPI, PostgreSQL, FAISS, Sentence-Transformers, Tesseract, React, Docker  
**Metrics:** Processes 1000+ page PDFs; sub-200ms semantic search; 95%+ OCR accuracy on clean docs  
**Key Challenge:** Hybrid keyword + vector search ranking; FAISS index optimization for memory-constrained deployment  

### 2. Mdaftari — Offline-First M-Pesa PWA
**Role:** Solo Full-Stack Engineer  
**Stack:** React, TypeScript, Vite, IndexedDB, Service Workers, M-Pesa Daraja  
**Metrics:** 100% offline-capable; <3s cold start; parses 5+ M-Pesa SMS formats  
**Key Challenge:** Service Worker update lifecycle; optimistic UI with unreliable SMS delivery; zero-server architecture  

### 3. 365 — Encrypted Cross-Platform Journaling (React Native)
**Role:** Solo Mobile Engineer  
**Stack:** React Native, Expo, TypeScript, SecureStore, SQLite, Biometric Auth  
**Metrics:** 60fps animations; AES-256 local encryption; FaceID/TouchID integration  
**Key Challenge:** Expo SecureStore limitations; encryption key management; media sync conflict resolution  

### 4. Zuri Estates / Sienna Paints / Starnex — Founder Platform Suite
**Role:** Sole Founder (Zuri) / Founder (Sienna, Starnex) — Technical Lead on all  
**Stack:** Next.js 14, TypeScript, Tailwind, Sanity CMS, Cloudinary, Mapbox, NextAuth, PostgreSQL  
**Metrics:** 216 properties / 707 paint SKUs / 739 industrial parts; 4-role auth; multi-currency; live revenue  
**Key Challenge:** Sanity schema design for complex product variants; Cloudinary transformation pipelines; Mapbox geo-queries at scale; multi-tenant theming across 3 brands  

### 5. vaafiti — 3D Multi-Tenant SaaS (Three.js + Tauri/Rust)
**Role:** Solo Full-Stack Engineer  
**Stack:** Three.js/R3F, Tauri (Rust), Next.js, Stripe, PostgreSQL  
**Metrics:** 60fps WebGL on mobile; <100ms tenant switch; Stripe Billing multi-tenant
